blocks.text: onSnapshot sends the current result and later changes. It returns a cleanup function that stops the listener.

Use the Firebase Emulator Suite with the demo-reading-club project and Firestore on port 8080. Install the firebase JavaScript SDK in a local browser project. Run each full snippet on a fresh page. Keep the sample rules local.

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `onSnapshot` supplies current data and later changes. Its returned function stops that listener.
`connectFirestoreEmulator` sends this SDK instance to the local emulator address before database operations begin.

blocks.text: The callback receives the current document and later allowed updates while listening.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Stop listeners you no longer need. A production listener can use network traffic and billed reads.
